changeSet.sql: -- Existing data has unsupported characters. -- Previously, we selected these values out of the response. -- Going forward, we'll be preventing inserts and updates with problematic values UPDATE data_access_request SET data = (SELECT (regexp_replace(data #>> '{}', '\\u0000', '', 'g'))::jsonb);
